title: Plate width parameter revision
purpose: Measure whether a direct parameter change updates the requested dimension while retaining unaffected dimensions.
complexityRationale: Two turns change one scalar dimension while two previously accepted dimensions remain invariant.

turns.text: Build a rectangular plate 30 mm wide, 20 mm deep, and 5 mm thick.
Change only the width to 45 mm. Keep the depth and thickness unchanged.

requirements.description: The current artifact envelope is 45 by 20 by 5 mm.
The accepted 20 mm depth and 5 mm thickness remain unchanged after the width revision.

forbiddenOutcomes.reason: Evidence for the original 30 mm artifact cannot prove the revised request.
The depth and thickness constraints remain active after the revision.

sourceSafety.notes: Synthetic two-turn parameter change authored for regression evaluation.
